title: MapScratch
tagline: Collaborative map markup for outdoor crews
description: MapScratch is a collaborative map annotation tool for outdoor enthusiasts. Drop pins, draw routes, and attach notes and photos to satellite maps, then share a link for friends to add their own marks and comments. Perfect for planning group hikes, fishing trips, or city explorations without the noise of social networks.
niche: Outdoor enthusiasts, hiking groups, fishing buddies, and urban explorers who want a shared visual planning space.
visualDirection: Dark, utilitarian workbench with a focused map canvas, side panels for lists and details, and a bold icon beat using a map-pin glyph on the hero.
features: Drop pins on an interactive Mapbox map with custom notes and optional photo URLs.
Draw freehand routes and polylines directly on the map.
Comment on any pin or route to update trail conditions or share ideas.
Share a unique link (via URL hash) to let friends open the same map and add their own marks.
Persist all data locally in the browser using localStorage, with demo data preloaded.
scopeNotes: No authentication, no backend, no payments. Map data and annotations stored in localStorage only. Mapbox used solely for the base map and drawing interactions. Share links encode a room ID in the hash but are only functional on the same browser (demo-friendly).
